non_claims: This is a two-frame pilot, not a full-video or multi-clip quality claim.
The text-vision experts emit normalized boxes that samurai rasterizes; they are not calibrated dense mask models.
Label-free calibration measures panel agreement and does not use the VOID reference as labels; the reference is used only for post-hoc evaluation.
No SAM 3.1 checkpoint, local SAM 3.1 inference, Netflix VOID model, CogVideoX, or VOID inpainting pass was executed.
Grok reached its free usage limit after two successful frame calls; the pilot was reduced rather than substituting synthetic Grok output.
GPU MODE source IDs can guide future visual downloads, but no GPU MODE video was downloaded and no license provenance was established for the downloaded YouTube files.
The cached sam3_masks directory has no durable command receipt proving that its mask was produced by a live SAM 3 model, so it was not counted as one of the three model experts.
